data.bottom_line: The most dangerous slopes will be found on northerly and east aspects near and above treeline, where slabs rest on top of weak faceted snow. These slopes will also look the most enticing to ski or ride. Watch for signs of instability like shooting cracks, loud audible collapses, or recent avalanches. These types of conditions can lead to remotely triggering avalanches from long distances away. Early-season conditions exist; watch for ground hazards like stumps, logs, and rocks that are buried just below the surface. We will update this General Avalanche Information product as more snow accumulates.
